config.description: The URL of your Dynatrace environment (e.g. 'https://abc12345.apps.dynatrace.com'). Do not use Dynatrace classic URLs.

config.label: [OPTIONAL] Dynatrace Platform Token for authentication
config.description: [OPTIONAL] Dynatrace Platform Token for authentication. Alternative to OAuth authentication.

config.label: [OPTIONAL] OAuth Client ID for advanced authentication scenarios
config.description: [OPTIONAL] OAuth Client ID for advanced authentication scenarios. Use with OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET.

config.label: [OPTIONAL] OAuth Client Secret for advanced authentication scenarios
config.description: [OPTIONAL] OAuth Client Secret for advanced authentication scenarios. Use with OAUTH_CLIENT_ID.

config.label: [OPTIONAL] Budget limit in GB for Grail query bytes scanned per session
config.description: [OPTIONAL] Budget limit in GB for Grail query bytes scanned per session. Default: 1000. Set to -1 to disable budget tracking.
